Messages.Body:
Ankou, The
Capacity: 10
Disciplines: AUS DEM OBF
Camarilla: When any vampire successfully hunts while the Ankou is
ready and untapped, the Ankou may burn that vampire as a (D) action
that turn (even on another Methuselah's turn).

Babble
Type: Reaction
Requires: Dementation
[dem] Give another ready minion +1 intercept.
[DEM] Tap this vampire to untap another ready minion. Not usable by a
blocking minion.

Question: Can Ankou be untapped by another reacting vampire using the
[DEM] effect of Babble in order to be able to use his special ability
on the same action ?

In other words: is the requirement "while the Ankou is ready and
untapped" relevant to the whole hunt action (from announcement to
resolution) or only to the moment when the hunt action is being
resolved as successful.

Thanx Jan

Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:

Sure, why not? The success of the action is determined at the end.
